question.text: Let <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> <math><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">tan</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cot</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math> Then the number of roots of the equation <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> in <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0,2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is

solution.text:
From the graph of tanx and cotx, we see that the range of fx is -1,0∪1,∞.
Hence, fx=max tan⁡x, cot⁡x and gx=12 do not cut each other
⇒ The number of solutions is zero.
